Rashi on Niddah 64a:11:1.hebrew: הני מילי היכא דקאים - ליה אותו יום ששינתה בו בתוך ימים שראויה להיות בהן נדה, כי מתני': שהיא למודה להיות רואה ביום ט"ו לטבילתה, שהוא כ"ב לראייתה, וכדאוקימנא בבנות כותים (לעיל נדה לט.), ושינתה ליום עשרים לטבילה, שהן עשרים ושבע לראייה, דכי הדר מטי יום ט"ו לטבילתה, קיימא לה בימים הראויים לנדה, שהרי שלמו לאחר טבילה י"א שבין נדה לנדה, ונכנסה ארבעה ימים בימים הראויים לנדות. אבל היכא דקאי בתוך ימי זיבתה — כגון שהיתה למודה לראות ליום חמשה עשר לטבילתה, והקדימה וראתה בתוך ימי הזוב, כגון ליום עשירי לטבילה:
Rashi on Niddah 64a:11:1.english: This applies where it stands - For her, that day on which she altered [her cycle], within days that she is fit to be a niddah, as in our mishna: where she is accustomed to seeing [blood] on the fifteenth day from her immersion, which is the twenty-second [day] from her sighting, as we established in [the chapter] "Banot Kutim" (above, Niddah 39a), and she changed to the twentieth day from immersion, which is twenty-seven [days] from sighting — so that when the fifteenth day from her immersion arrives again, she is standing in the days fit for niddah, for after immersion the eleven [days] between niddah and niddah have completed, and she has entered four days into the days fit for niddah. But where it falls within the days of her zivah — such as where she was accustomed to seeing on the fifteenth day from her immersion, and she saw earlier, within the days of zivah, such as on the tenth day from immersion:

Rashi on Niddah 64a:11:2.hebrew: אימא לא - תיחוש לה, דכי מטיא טבילתה אחריתי ותטבול ויגיע יום עשרים לא תאסר לשמש, דהא קיימא לן בפרק דלעיל (נדה דף לט.): כל אחד עשר בחזקת טהרה, שאינה מוחזקת רואה. הלכך, משום חדא זימנא לא תיחוש לה, דאקראי בעלמא הוה — קמ"ל:
Rashi on Niddah 64a:11:2.english: I would say [she does] not - [Need to] be concerned for it, so that when her next immersion arrives and she immerses, and the twentieth day arrives, she would not be forbidden to engage in marital relations. For we maintain in the preceding chapter (Niddah 39a): "All eleven [days] are in the presumption of purity, as she is not presumed to see [blood]." Therefore, on account of one time she should not be concerned for it, as it was a mere happenstance. [Rav Pappa] teaches us [that she must nevertheless be concerned].

Rashi on Niddah 64a:13:1.hebrew: תנינא אין האשה קובעת ואינה מטהרת - ומדתנא להו גבי הדדי, משמע דלא בעי עקירה שלש פעמים אלא למי שנקבע שלש פעמים:
Rashi on Niddah 64a:13:1.english: We have learned: A woman does not establish, and she is not purified - And since [the mishna] taught them next to each other, it implies that uprooting three times is not required except for [a cycle] that was established three times.

Rashi on Niddah 64a:13:2.hebrew: חד לחד - חדא עקירה לחד קביעות, וקא משמע לן דאפילו קבעתיה תרי זימני, מיעקרא בחד זימנא:
Rashi on Niddah 64a:13:2.english: One for one - One uprooting for one establishment [of a cycle], and [Rav Pappa] teaches us that even if she established it two times, it is uprooted in one time.

Rashi on Niddah 64a:14:1.hebrew: כוותיה - דאפילו קבעתיה תרי זימני, מיעקר בחד זימנא:
Rashi on Niddah 64a:14:1.english: In accordance with him - That even if she established it twice, it is displaced by a single time.

Rashi on Niddah 64a:14:2.english: This is the correct reading: She is permitted to engage in intercourse until the thirtieth day - All the intervening days are permitted.

Rashi on Niddah 64a:15:1.hebrew: הגיע יום שלשים ולא ראתה הגיע יום עשרים וראתה הותר שלשים - העתיד לבא, דהא איעקר מינה. ואף על גב דקבעתיה תרי זימני, מיעקר בחד זימנא:
Rashi on Niddah 64a:15:1.english: The thirtieth day arrived and she did not see, the twentieth day arrived and she saw, the thirtieth [day] became permitted - [The thirtieth day] that is to come, for it has been uprooted from her. And even though she established it twice, it is uprooted by a single time.

Rashi on Niddah 64a:1:1.hebrew: קבעה לה וסת לדילוג - ואסורה ליום י"ח לחדש רביעי, וליום י"ט בחדש חמישי, וכן לעולם:
Rashi on Niddah 64a:1:1.english: She has established for herself a cycle by skipping - And she is forbidden [to her husband] on the eighteenth day of the fourth month, and on the nineteenth day of the fifth month, and so on forever.

Rashi on Niddah 64a:1:2.hebrew: עד שתשלש בדילוג - ויום ט"ו אינו מן המנין, שהוא תחלת ראייתה, ואין שם דילוג:
Rashi on Niddah 64a:1:2.english: Until she does [so] three times by skipping - And the fifteenth day is not included in the count, as it is the beginning of her sighting, and there is no skip there.

Rashi on Niddah 64a:4:1.hebrew: היתה למודה - וסת קבוע לט"ו, ושינתה לי"ו — זה וזה אסורין, כלומר: כשיגיע ט"ו וי"ו עוד, תאסר. חזרה ושינתה בשניה [לשבעה עשר] — הותר ט"ז מכאן ואילך, שלא קבעתו אלא פעם אחת, הלכך בפעם אחת הוא נעקר:
Rashi on Niddah 64a:4:1.english: [If] she was accustomed - [She had] a fixed period on the fifteenth, and she changed to the sixteenth — "both this and that are forbidden," that is to say, when the fifteenth and sixteenth arrive again, she will be forbidden [to her husband]. She changed again on the second [occasion] [to the seventeenth] — the sixteenth is permitted from here on, for she had established it only once; therefore, with one time it is uprooted.

Rashi on Niddah 64a:5:1.hebrew: הותרו כולן - ט"ו, שהרי עקרתו שלשה פעמים, וט"ז וי"ז בחדא זימנא מיעקר. ואפילו י"ח הבא לא יאסר אלא י"ט, כדקתני "משמונה עשר ואילך", שהרי שילשה בדילוג וקבעה לה וסת לדילוג:
Rashi on Niddah 64a:5:1.english: All of them are permitted - [The] fifteenth [day is permitted], since she uprooted it three times, and the sixteenth and seventeenth are uprooted in a single instance. And even the upcoming eighteenth [day] will not be forbidden, but rather the nineteenth, as [the baraita] teaches: "From eighteen and onward," for she tripled with skipping and established for herself a cycle by skipping.

Rashi on Niddah 64a:5:2.hebrew: תיובתא דרב - דהא קתני: "שינתה לשבעה עשר נאסר ט"ו וי"ו", ולא קתני "מי"ז ואילך", ואע"ג דדילגה ב' זימני — אלמא ראייה קמייתא לאו ממנינא:
Rashi on Niddah 64a:5:2.english: A refutation of Rav - For [the baraita] teaches: "[If] she changed to the seventeenth, the fifteenth and sixteenth are prohibited," and it does not teach "from the seventeenth and onward," even though she skipped twice; evidently, the first sighting is not included in the count.

Rashi on Niddah 64a:5:3.hebrew: למודה שאני - כיון דוסתה קבוע לט"ו, שדינן ראייה של ט"ו עם ראיות שעברו עליה, שהרי בזמנה ראתה. והיכי הוה מצינן למימנייה עם הני דדילוג? וכי אמינא אנא, היכא דראיית ט"ו שהיתה תחלת ראייתה, או שלא היה לה וסת קודם לכן, או שהיה לה וסת ליום עשרים:
Rashi on Niddah 64a:5:3.english: [A woman who was] accustomed is different - Since her fixed cycle was established for the fifteenth, we cast the sighting of the fifteenth with her past sightings, for she saw [blood] at her [regular] time. And how could we have counted it with those [sightings] of the skipping? And when I said [that she establishes a fixed cycle], [it was] where the sighting of the fifteenth was the beginning of her seeing [blood], or where she had no fixed cycle prior to this, or where she had a fixed cycle for the twentieth day.

Rashi on Niddah 64a:6:1.hebrew: ודקארי לה מאי קארי לה - הא ודאי, היכי מצי לאקשויי מלמודה:
Rashi on Niddah 64a:6:1.english: And he who cited it, why did he cite it? - This is certainly [so]: How could he raise an objection from [a woman who was] accustomed?

Rashi on Niddah 64a:6:2.hebrew: קס"ד: ה"ה לשאינה למודה בעינן תלתא זימני דילוג. והאי דנקט למודה — לאו משום עקירת וסת דילוג, למידק דלמודה הוא דבעי שתשלש בדילוג; אלא משום עקירת וסת ראשון, דקתני: חזרה ושינתה לי"ז, הותר ט"ז ונאסר ט"ו וי"ז, ואע"ג דעקרתיה לט"ו תרי זימני, דסד"א: כיון דלמודה הואי בט"ו ועקרתיה ב' זימני — תו לא הדרה, ותשתרי לט"ו הבא:
Rashi on Niddah 64a:6:2.english: [The Gemara initially] thought: The same applies to [a woman who was] not accustomed [to a fixed cycle], that we require three instances of skipping. And this [fact] that [the baraita] formulated [the case with a woman who was] accustomed was not on account of uprooting a cycle [by] skipping, to infer that [only] one who is accustomed is required to do [so] three times by skipping; but rather on account of uprooting the first cycle, for [the baraita] teaches: [If] she then changed to the seventeenth, the sixteenth is permitted and the fifteenth and seventeenth are forbidden — even though she uprooted [the cycle of the] fifteenth twice. For it would enter your mind to say: Since she was accustomed to the fifteenth and uprooted it twice, it will not return anymore, and she should be permitted on the upcoming fifteenth.

Rashi on Niddah 64a:6:3.english: It teaches us - That an established fixed period is not uprooted in fewer than three times.

Rashi on Niddah 64a:7:1.english: She skipped - From the twenty-second day to the twenty-fourth day.

Rashi on Niddah 64a:7:2.hebrew: לא קבעה לה וסת - שאין דילוג זה דומה לראשון, דראשון יום אחד, וזה שני ימים כאחד. קתני מיהא: קבעה לה וסת, בג' ראיות, וראשונה בכלל:
Rashi on Niddah 64a:7:2.english: She has not established for herself a fixed period - Because this skip is not similar to the first [skip], as the first was [a skip of] one day, and this [one was a skip of] two days at once. In any event, it teaches [in the first clause]: "She has established for herself a fixed period" with three sightings, and the first [sighting] is included [in the count].

Rashi on Niddah 64a:8:1.english: And she changed to the twenty-first day - So that there is a skip three times.

Rashi on Niddah 64a:8:2.hebrew: דיקא נמי מדשבקינן ליום עשרים - דהוה ליה למיתני: ראתה ביום עשרים בחדש זה, ויום עשרים ואחד בחדש זה, ויום עשרים ושנים בחדש זה, שכן דרך לשון תנאים לשנות כלל ולשון קצרה:
Rashi on Niddah 64a:8:2.english: [The wording] is also precise from [the fact] that we left aside the twentieth day - For it should have taught: "She saw on the twentieth day of this month, and the twenty-first day of this month, and the twenty-second day of this month," for such is the way of the language of the Tannaim, to teach a round number and concise phrasing.

Rashi on Niddah 64a:9:1.hebrew: לא אמרן - דאין קובעת עד שתקבענו שלש פעמים, אלא למקבעיה, דתהוי דיה שעתה, ולא יעקר בפחות מג':
Rashi on Niddah 64a:9:1.english: We did not say - That she does not establish [a fixed cycle] until she establishes it three times, except with regard to establishing it, so that her time will be sufficient for her and it will not be uprooted in fewer than three [times].

Rashi on Niddah 64a:9:2.hebrew: אבל למיחש בחדא זימנא חיישא - ליה, שאם ראתה ביום ט"ו פעם אחת, חוששת לט"ו הבא ולא תשמש:
Rashi on Niddah 64a:9:2.english: But with regard to being concerned, after one time she is concerned - For it: That if she saw [blood] on the fifteenth day once, she is concerned for the next fifteenth [day] and may not engage in marital relations.

Tosafot on Niddah 64a:1:1.hebrew: איתמר ראתה ט"ו בחדש זה וט"ז בחדש זה - פי' דווקא בכי האי גוונא; אבל ראתה בג' חדשים, או בב' לחדש או באחד, לכ"ע אין צריך יותר, כדאמר לעיל בסוף בנות כותים (נדה דף לט:) דחזאי ריש ירחא וריש ירחא כו'. ואפילו שאחד מלא ואחד חסר, ואין הימים שבין ראייה לראייה שוין, מ"מ קביעות החדש גורם. והיכא דבראשונה אין לה שיעור בחדש שתהא השניה נראת דילוג מן הראשונה, דכ"ע דאין הראשונה מן המנין, ובעינן שתשלש בדילוג — כגון ראתה עכשיו, ושניה בעשרים לה, ושלישית בכ"א לשניה; ומשום הכי נקט ט"ו בחדש זה. ולפירוש זה קשה, דבפרק שור שנגח ד' וה' (ב"ק לז:) מדמה נגח יום חמשה עשר בחדש זה, וששה עשר בחדש זה, ושבעה עשר בחדש זה לפלוגתא דהכא. ואם כן, היכי קאמר התם לעיל גבי ראה שור ונגח שור ולא נגח דהויא ראשונה מן המנין? הא בכי האי גונא, אפי' רב מודה דלא הוי ראשונה מן המנין, שהרי לא היתה לשום זמן, לא לחדש ולא לשבת! ויש לחלק בין סירוגין דימים לסירוגין דשוורים. ור"ח פי': קבעה לה וסת לדילוג — כשעשתה שלש פעמים כסדר הזה, כגון שראתה ט"ו בניסן, וי"ו באייר, וי"ז בסיון; וכן ראתה ט"ו בתמוז, וי"ו באב, וי"ז באלול; ועוד ראתה ט"ו בתשרי, וי"ו במרחשון, וי"ז בכסליו — חוששת מכאן ואילך ט"ו לחדש זה, וי"ו לשני, וי"ז לשלישי. ולשמואל, צריכה שתשלש בדילוג, שתראה בחדש רביעי יום י"ח, ובג' חדשים שאחריהם יום י"ו וי"ז וי"ח, וכן בשלישי עוד שאחרי כן, דראייה של ט"ו יום בחדש הראשון לא היה ממנינא. ותימה: למה פי' כן? דא"כ, כששאל הש"ס: "לימא בדרבי ורשב"ג קמיפלגי", לא פליגי בראייה ראשונה לחוד, אלא בשלש ראיות של דילוג ראשון; ובמסקנא יהיה הפירוש בע"א! ואמאי לא סגי בג' חדשים כדפי' בקונטרס:
Tosafot on Niddah 64a:1:1.english: It was stated: If she saw on the fifteenth of this month and on the sixteenth of this month - The explanation is that [this dispute applies] specifically in this kind of case. But if she saw in three months [consistently], either on the second of the month or on the first [of the month], according to all, no more [sightings] are needed [than three], as [the Gemara] says above at the end of [the chapter] *Banot Kutim* (Niddah 39b): "where she saw on Rosh Chodesh, and on Rosh Chodesh, etc." And even though one [month] is full (thirty days) and one is defective (twenty-nine days), so that the days between sighting and sighting are not equal, nevertheless, the fixed day of the month is the determining factor (*kevi'ut ha-chodesh gorem*). And where, in the first [sighting], she has no set point in the month such that the second would appear as a skip from the first, everyone agrees that the first is not of the count, and we require that she skip three times — for example, where she saw now, and the second was on the twentieth [day] from it, and the third on the twenty-first from the second; and for this reason, [the Amora] specified "the fifteenth of this month." And according to this explanation, it is difficult: for in the chapter *Shor She-Nagach Arba'ah Va-Chamishah* (Bava Kamma 37b), [the Gemara] compares [a case where an ox] gored on the fifteenth day of this month, and on the sixteenth day of this month, and on the seventeenth day of this month, to the dispute here. And if so, how does [the Gemara] say there above, regarding [an ox that] saw an ox and gored, [and then saw an] ox and did not gore, that the first [goring] is of the count? For in such a case, even Rav would concede that the first is not of the count, as it was not at any fixed time — neither to the month nor to Shabbat! But one can distinguish between alternating [intervals] of days and alternating [occurrences] of oxen. And Rabbeinu Chananel explained: "She has established a *veset* for skipping" [means] when she has done [so] three times according to this order: for example, she saw on the fifteenth of Nisan, the sixteenth of Iyyar, and the seventeenth of Sivan; and similarly, she saw on the fifteenth of Tammuz, the sixteenth of Av, and the seventeenth of Elul; and furthermore, she saw on the fifteenth of Tishrei, the sixteenth of Marcheshvan, and the seventeenth of Kislev — from here on, she anticipates the fifteenth of this month, the sixteenth of the second, and the seventeenth of the third. And according to Shmuel, she must skip three times, [meaning] that she must see in a fourth month on day eighteen, and in the three months after them on day sixteen, day seventeen, and day eighteen, and similarly in the third [set] further after that, as the sighting of day fifteen in the first month was not of the count. And it is astonishing: why did he explain this way? For if so, when the Talmud asked: "Shall we say that they disagree in [the dispute of] Rabbi and Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel?", they would not be disagreeing regarding the first sighting alone, but rather regarding the three sightings of the first skip; and in the conclusion, the explanation would be in a different manner! And why should three months not suffice, as explained in the Kuntres [by Rashi]?

Tosafot on Niddah 64a:5:1.hebrew: ואינה אסורה אלא מי"ח ואילך - וא"ת: ויאסר נמי יום י"ח כי שינתה לי"ז, שהרי דילגה, ויהיה בכלל וסת דילוג, כמו ט"ו וי"ו דחיישינן בחדא זימנא? ואומר הר"י, דאין לחוש בדילוג משום חדא זימנא:
Tosafot on Niddah 64a:5:1.english: And she is forbidden only from the eighteenth and onward - And if you say: Let the eighteenth day also be forbidden when she changed to the seventeenth, for behold, she skipped, and let it be included in [the category of] a skipping cycle (veset ha-dilug), just as [with] the fifteenth and the sixteenth, where we are concerned for a single occurrence? And the Ri says that one is not concerned about a skip on account of a single occurrence.

Tosafot on Niddah 64a:9:1.hebrew: מיחש בחדא זימנא חיישינן - פירש"י דחיישינן לתשמיש, וכן צריך לפרש, מדלא פרי' הש"ס בהדיא לטהרות. ואין להזכיר בשום קביעות וסת ג' פעמים לגבי תשמיש, דהא בחדא זימנא חיישינן, אלא לגבי שאם נקבעו שלש פעמים, חוששין לו עד שיעקר שלש פעמים:
Tosafot on Niddah 64a:9:1.english: With regard to being concerned, we are concerned after a single time - Rashi explained that we are concerned regarding marital relations. And so it must be explained, since the Gemara did not explicitly specify [that it is] regarding [ritual] purities (taharot). And there is no mention of three times in any establishment of a fixed cycle (veset) regarding marital relations — since after a single time we are [already] concerned — except with regard to [the rule] that if it was established three times, one is concerned for it until it is uprooted three times.
